scripts.build:native: cd native/wgc-exclude && npm install && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:native && npm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist: npm run build:native && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --win --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.release:win: npm run build:native && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish always --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.release:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish always --config electron-builder.config.js
